sloka: कुरुष्व मामनुचरम् वैधर्म्यम् नेह विद्यते ।कृतार्थोऽहम् भविष्यामि तव चार्थः प्रकल्पते ॥२-३१-२२॥
transliteration: kuruṣva māmanucaram vaidharmyam neha vidyate ।kṛtārtho'ham bhaviṣyāmi tava cārthaḥ prakalpate ॥2-31-22॥

translations.english: Make me your follower. There is no breach of virtue in this. I will have my purpose accomplished. Your object also will be fulfilled.
